part.text:
Implemented case-insensitive `content-encoding` handling in `lib/adapters/http.js:555`, so values like `GZIP`, `GZip`, etc. are normalized before choosing the decompressor. Also guarded against the header having been deleted for `HEAD`/`204` responses.

Compression tests (33 passing) and ESLint pass. The full HTTP suite's 5 unrelated failures are environment/network/DNS-dependent.
